records.title: Peja orchards in the 2014 Agricultural Census
records.description: ASK recorded 233.02 hectares of orchard plantations in Peja municipality in 2014: 176.70 hectares of apples, 28.52 hectares of plums, and 8.92 hectares of pears. Historical census context only; not a current production, availability, or seller claim.

records.title: Peja livestock in the 2014 Agricultural Census
records.description: ASK recorded 18,199 cattle, including 8,893 dairy cows, 8,599 sheep, and 1,420 goats in Peja municipality in 2014. These are historical animal counts, not current farm output or marketplace availability.

records.title: Rugova and its villages
records.description: Peja Municipality describes Rugova as northwest of Peja and says the region includes 15 villages. No farm coordinates or private addresses are included.

records.title: Foods named in Peja Municipality tourism material
records.description: Municipal tourism material names milk, cheese, yogurt, honey, mountain tea, lakror, flija, and kaçamak. It lists Restaurant Bjeshka at Garuzhda (Shtypeq i Madh). This is cultural/tourism context, not proof of current production, supply, or PejaMarket participation.

records.title: Historical report of vegetables supplied from Peja
records.description: A 2020 article reports a Prishtina restaurant received squash, carrots, and peppers from an unnamed farmer in Peja. The farmer is not identified, and this does not establish a current supply relationship or an available PejaMarket seller.

records.title: Restaurant Bjeshka (municipal tourism listing)
records.description: Peja Municipality's tourism material locates this food venue at Garuzhda (Shtypeq i Madh) and lists traditional foods. It is a restaurant, not a verified farm, producer, marketplace seller, or PejaMarket member; current status and sourcing are unverified.
